Contributing to ComPoM

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome at https://github.com/dragonfly-science/ComPoM.

Bug reports

Open an issue with a minimal reproducible example. ex_comp and ex_catch (see ?ex_data) are bundled so that examples can use them. Include sessionInfo(), and the sdmTMB and brms versions.

Development

devtools::load_all()
devtools::document()                      # regenerate man/ and NAMESPACE (roxygen2)
devtools::test()                          # unit and regression tests
devtools::check(vignettes = FALSE)        # as in CI
  • Edit the roxygen comments in R/, not the files in man/. CI fails if man/ or NAMESPACE are out of date.
  • Add a test for each change in behaviour, and a line to NEWS.md.
  • The brms tests need rstan and a C++ toolchain, and are skipped if rstan is not installed.
  • The vignettes are slow (the spatial vignette takes about 10 minutes). Render them with rmarkdown::render() from the vignettes/ directory when changing the model or the plots.
  • data-raw/ex_data.R regenerates the example data.
